name: Steady bike ride
description: A steady pace, breathing in rhythm.

name: Stair climb challenge
description: Climb steadily with short recovery breaks.
caution: Stairs load the knees. Take breaks and stop if you feel sharp joint pain.

name: Dance cardio party
description: Put on a song and move to it.

name: Brisk walk reset
description: A fresh-air walk at a brisk, relaxed pace.

name: Jump rope bursts
description: Short bursts of skipping with rest.
caution: Jumping loads the ankles and calves. Land softly and stop if you feel sharp pain.

name: Rowing machine steady
description: Steady pulls at a consistent stroke rate.

name: Low-impact step cardio
description: Easy step-ups with a gentle arm swing.

name: Fartlek run
description: Alternate faster and slower running as you feel like it.

name: Elliptical intervals
description: Push hard for short bursts, then ease off.
caution: Keep an eye on your breathing. Stop if you feel chest pain or dizziness.

name: Swim-style easy laps
description: Relaxed laps at a comfortable pace.

name: Air bike sprints
description: Short hard efforts with full recovery.
caution: Sprint efforts are demanding. Warm up first and stop if you feel dizzy or sharp pain.

name: Lazy cardio circuit
description: A small circuit of easy moves to get your heart beating.
